subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild channel authorization support explicit channel-name patterns, and where should those patterns rank relative to exact id/name/slug, thread-parent, category, and literal `*` entries?
rationale: This adds a public configuration contract on an inbound authorization boundary; different syntax and precedence choices can admit unintended messages or suppress intended ones, so implementation convenience cannot safely choose the policy.

options.title: Add explicit patterns
options.body: Introduce a dedicated pattern map with documented syntax, escaping, deterministic precedence, and authorization-focused tests.

options.title: Use category inheritance
options.body: Keep channel keys exact and satisfy category-organized dynamic workflows through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60582.

options.title: Keep exact allowlists
options.body: Retain explicit channel entries and address restart latency separately through the reload work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90865.

recommendation.title: Add explicit patterns
recommendation.body: Introduce a dedicated pattern map with documented syntax, escaping, deterministic precedence, and authorization-focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the shared matching precedence and already supplied item-specific review context for the same authorization boundary.
